retainedExperiments: Shared activity ordering, half-length scratch and private token reuse were measured separately; all earlier observations remain in the archive.
Explicitly clearing the root-index temporary did not establish a reliable memory benefit and was reverted.
Exact child sizing reduces excess child capacity and selected large-case RSS; the extra counting pass remains checkpointed.
Swift macro compilation initially failed under the process sandbox; the preserved failure was followed by a successful authorised build outside that sandbox.
limitations: Public API and CLI effort remain 3. This does not expose higher efforts or establish production readiness.

Process peak RSS varies with allocation history. The earlier single-grey memory increase and all outliers remain recorded; this is not an allocator-level attribution or peak algorithm workspace measurement.
Cumulative admission remains deliberately conservative and unchanged, even where live arrays are smaller.
Bounded loop checks do not provide a real-time cancellation guarantee for allocation, COW or runtime work.
Timing uses serial internal encoding without a budget context. Worker-budget probes are not concurrent steady-state memory qualification.
Local Swift 6.4 arm64 evidence does not qualify hosted Swift 6.2, Linux, physical Apple devices or minimum OS runtime.

Broader Modular predecessor performance, VarDCT ARM reference differences, JPEG and animation, feature reconciliation and Apple runtime gates remain open. Milestone 4 is incomplete; JXLSwift remains the supported production route.
